newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Unihold sells units for 26.4 mln rand.
newsitem.headline: Unihold sells units for 26.4 mln rand.

text.p: South Africa's Unihold Ltd said on Friday its wholly-owned unit Unihold Group Ltd had disposed of a number of its assets in deal worth 26.4 million rand.

Unihold Group Ltd had agreed in principle to sell its 90 percent shareholding in Parker Manufacturing (Pty) Ltd, Exipro (Swaziland) (Pty) Ltd and the assets of the plumbing brassware division of Probrass (Pty) Ltd and most of its remaining property interests.

The company said the assets had been sold to Thermo-Chill (Pty) Ltd -- acting on behalf of a consortium which includes Parker, Exipro and Probrass management and James Haslam, current Unihold chairman.
In addition to the purchase price of 26.4 million rand, a further 2.7 million rand which was advanced on loan account to the three companies by Unihold will also be payable.
Unihold said it was involved in further talks on a potential acquisition which could affect its share price. The company cautioned shareholders to exercise caution in their share dealings.
